planning_notes: Board is Arduino UNO. Control period chosen as 5 ms as scheduling granularity; business/report cadence to be handled in SysML using elapsed_ms.
LM35 (A1) and MQ-2 (A0) are modeled as analog_input f64 with catalog default ADC unit; actual conversion to degC and smoke units is a SysML/model task (not provided).

Flame sensor on D2 is modeled as digital_input with model value true meaning 'flame detected'. Polarity (active-high vs active-low) was not provided by circuit facts; default digital_input polarity is used.

TM1637 requirement specifies CLK=D4 and DIO=D5; numeric display behavior (what exact number encodes which level and how key value is encoded) is assumed to be defined in SysML. No digit segment/wiring details were provided, so only the tm1637_number catalog port is created.
LEDs: D13 red and D12 green are modeled as digital_output with model true turning them on. Whether they are active-high in hardware was not specified; catalog default for digital_output is used.

Buzzer on D6 is modeled using tone_output with initial 0 (silence). Exact intermittent pattern (on/off durations) and whether tone frequency is fixed or state-dependent are to be implemented in SysML.

Serial: Only one reporting gate group is created for 'fire alert / alarm status' as described (fire alert in alarm level). Exact message format beyond typed values is not specified, so dynamic fixed text is not introduced.
Unused serial input requirements (serial_command_input / serial_integer_input) are not created because no RX protocol or control commands were specified.

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个多传感器火灾预警系统，使用温度传感器 LM35（A1）、烟雾传感器 MQ-2（A0）、火焰传感器 D2、蜂鸣器 D6、红色 LED D13、绿色 LED D12、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和串口。系统将预警分为正常、关注、警报三级：任一指标轻微超限进入关注，多个指标超限或火焰传感器触发进入警报。数码管显示当前等级编号和关键值；警报级下蜂鸣器持续间歇报警并串口输出 fire alert。
